chapters.title: Map, On this day and Stats
chapters.purpose: Three ways to look at the whole library: where you took photos (Map), what you shot on this date in other years (On this day), and how you shoot and what you keep (Stats).
intro: All three read the catalog only. The Map draws dots on a plain grid until you turn online map tiles on - then OpenStreetMap's map pictures are fetched (only tile numbers are asked for; nothing about your photos is sent) and kept in the data folder.

workflows.title: See the photos from one place
steps: Open Map in the sidebar.
Drag to move and use the mouse wheel (or + / -) to zoom; Fit shows every photo.
Click a numbered circle: the library opens with just those photos.

workflows.title: Look back at today in other years
steps: Open On this day. It starts on today's date.
Each year with photos on that date is a row with a strip of photos; Show all opens them in the library.
Step a day with ‹ / ›, pick a date, or tick Within 3 days for the week around it.

workflows.title: Find your best-kept lens
steps: Open Stats.
Choose Keeper rate by: Lens. Each bar is the photos taken with that lens; the dark part is the ones you flagged Pick, with the rate beside it.
Focal lengths on a lens shows where a zoom really gets used.

edge_cases.situation: The Map is a grid with dots, no map.
edge_cases.what_happens: Online map tiles are off (the default). Click Show map tiles (online) to turn them on; once a tile is fetched it's kept, so it works offline after.
It isn't on the Map. Photos at 0, 0 (a camera with no GPS fix) are left out too.
A keeper is a photo flagged Pick (P). Flag your best photos and the rates fill in.

chapters.title: Videos
chapters.purpose: Videos and animated GIFs play in the photo view, and a clip can be trimmed to a new, shorter file. Sony S-Log3 clips play through a look that makes them watchable without grading.
intro: The original clip is never changed: a trim is a new file in the Create folder, copied without re-encoding (quick and lossless), starting at the keyframe just before your start mark.

workflows.title: Trim a clip
steps: Open the video like a photo (double-click it).
Play to where the copy should start and click Start here (or press I).
Play on to where it should end and click End here (or press O).
Click Save trimmed copy. The message links to the new file and its folder.

workflows.title: Compare an S-Log3 clip with its look
steps: Open an S-Log3 clip (recognised from the camera's XML sidecar).
It plays through the look chosen in Settings > Library; Show log shows it as recorded while held on.

edge_cases.what_happens: Lunelis says it couldn't play the file. Open with default app (in the Info panel) plays it in Windows' own player.
Plays and pauses it. Left / Right still go to the previous or next photo.

chapters.title: Culling, asking and shortcuts
chapters.purpose: Culling sorts a shoot from the keyboard in full screen; Ask finds photos from a sentence; the shortcut sheet lists every key.
intro: Culling (Ctrl+K) shows the selection - or everything the library shows - one at a time, or 2-4 side by side zooming together. A burst's frames are all shown, so you choose between them.

workflows.title: Cull a shoot
steps: Select the shoot in the library and press Ctrl+K.
P picks, X rejects, 0-5 rates; with auto-advance on it moves to the next photo.
C compares 2, 3 or 4 photos; Tab chooses which one the keys act on; Z zooms all together.
Ctrl+Z undoes a mistake. Esc goes back to the library.

workflows.title: Ask your library
steps: Click Ask beside the search box (or press Ctrl+Shift+F).
Type a sentence: "sunset on a beach, A7R V, 2024, 4 stars".
The chips show how it was read; remove one to loosen the search. The best matches come first.

edge_cases.situation: Ask understood only part of a sentence.
edge_cases.what_happens: Camera, lens, dates and stars are read exactly; the rest is matched against what's in the photos when scene tags are on (Settings > Library). Without them, the rest searches names and tags.

chapters.title: Library status and Lunelis noticed
chapters.purpose: The Library status page shows what Lunelis is doing to the library and how the library is - and what Lunelis noticed in your shoots: brackets, panoramas, focus stacks, timelapses and star trails it offers to build.
intro: Nothing is built without your click. A dismissed suggestion is never offered again.

workflows.title: Build what Lunelis noticed
steps: Open Library status.
Under Lunelis noticed, look at the frames of a suggestion.
Build the HDR... / Build the panorama... opens the merge; Make the timelapse... / focus stack... / star trails... opens the Create tool with those frames.
Show photos shows them in the library; Dismiss takes the suggestion away for good.

edge_cases.what_happens: Its drive or NAS isn't answering. Its photos stay in the library from their thumbnails, marked OFFLINE; nothing is marked missing.

chapters.title: Sensor dust
chapters.purpose: Dust on a camera's sensor shows as the same soft dark blot in many photos. The Sensor dust page finds it per camera and heals it out of the photos as edits.
intro: Healing adds Heal spots to the photos' edits - the files never change - and Undo the last heal takes them off again.

workflows.title: Find and heal dust
steps: Open Sensor dust (Keep safe). Pick the camera.
Click Look for dust. The map shows each spot: solid while it's there, dashed once a cleaning removed it.
Show the photos to check them, then Heal on N photos. Lunelis asks first.
Undo the last heal if you change your mind.

edge_cases.what_happens: Dust shows best at f/8 and narrower on plain bright areas; with few such photos there may be nothing to go on.
Photos rotated or flipped in Lunelis are skipped (the sensor's corners moved); the message says how many.

chapters.title: Review your shoot (Autopilot)
chapters.purpose: With Autopilot ticked on the Import page, Lunelis sorts out an imported shoot in stages - best burst frames, scene tags, an event, edits in your style, a draft album, a highlight reel - and waits for you to review it.
intro: Nothing is set aside, deleted, renamed or edited before you've reviewed it: edits and the reel wait for Apply / Make it, and every other stage can be undone.

workflows.title: Review a shoot
steps: When the import is done, click Review it on the Import page (or the tray message).
Undo any stage you don't want; Apply the edits; Make it for the highlight reel.
Show the photos to look at the shoot; Done reviewing keeps what's left.

edge_cases.situation: A stage says it was skipped.
edge_cases.what_happens: It couldn't run - no scene model yet, fewer than 15 edits to learn your look from - and says why. Turn stages on or off in Settings > Library.

chapters.title: Sharing an album at home
chapters.purpose: Share an album with the family's phones and TV on your home network - a link and a QR code, no accounts, nothing on the internet.
intro: Only home-network addresses are answered. Each shared album has its own long random key; an optional PIN is stored only as a salted hash; guests see resized copies without location; the originals only if you allow it.

workflows.title: Share an album
steps: On the Albums page, right-click an album > Share on the home network...
Optionally type a PIN (4-12 digits) and tick Allow downloading the original files.
Click Share. Copy the link, or point a phone's camera at the QR code.
Stop sharing makes the link useless at once.

workflows.title: Make a smart album
steps: On the Albums page click New smart album...
Choose whether photos must match all rules or any, and add rules (ISO at least 3200, 4 stars or more, a lens...).
Save. The album keeps itself up to date.

workflows.title: Accept scene suggestions
steps: Open Tags > Scene suggestions.
Pick a suggested tag; tick the photos that really show it.
Accept ticked (or Accept all above a confidence - it asks first). Rejected ones aren't suggested again.

edge_cases.situation: A phone can't open the link.
edge_cases.what_happens: It must be on the same home network. Windows may have asked whether Lunelis may accept connections on private networks - allow it.

edge_cases.situation: Update with the PIN field empty.
edge_cases.what_happens: Keeps the PIN. Tick Remove the PIN to take it off.

screen_text.sensor_dust: Sensor dust: a camera's dust map and the photos it would heal.
screen_text.review_shoot: Review your shoot: what the autopilot did, stage by stage, each with its answer.
screen_text.scene_suggestions: Tags > Scene suggestions: tags the scene model suggested, waiting for your accept.
screen_text.ask: Ask your library: a sentence becomes a search; the chips show how it was read.
screen_text.video: The photo view playing a video, with the trim controls.

screen_text.dialog_shortcuts: Every keyboard shortcut, for the screen you're on first (press ?).

Ask.does: Opens Ask your library: find photos from a sentence.

Backup.does: Filters to photos that are backed up, or not.
Backup.inputs: Choose Backed up or Not backed up.
Backup.notes: A photo counts as backed up when a backup holds a good copy of it.

On this day.does: Opens the On this day page.

Create.does: Opens the Create page (and folds or unfolds the Create group when it's the group heading).

Collapse.does: Folds the sidebar to icons only (Expand brings the names back).
Collapse.notes: Settings > Appearance can fold it on narrow windows by itself.

Move the Archive to a drive….does: Moves the archived photos to another drive (through Migrate).

Undo.does: Takes back the last change to stars, labels, flags, tags, albums, events, the archive, stacks or edits on many photos.
Undo.notes: Edit mode has its own undo for the photo being edited.

Redo.does: Puts back what Undo took away.

Cull full screen….does: Opens culling for the selection (or everything showing).

More like these.does: Shows photos that look like the selected ones, best first.
More like these.notes: Needs scene tags turned on (Settings > Library).

Archive.does: Archives the selected photos: kept, but out of the library's view (the Archive album shows them).

Open in the Edit page.does: Opens the selected photos on the Edit page, the editing workspace.

All metadata.does: Unfolds every tag the file carries.
All metadata.notes: Text from the file is shown as text only.

Show in folder.does: Opens the photo's folder in Explorer with the file selected.

Open with default app.does: Opens the file in Windows' own program for it.

My look.does: Suggests an edit in your style, learned on this PC from your own edits.
My look.inputs: Click; the suggestion shows with Apply and Not now.
My look.notes: Needs 15 edited photos. Nothing changes until Apply; Ctrl+Z undoes it.

Proof.does: Soft proof: shows how the photo will print with the profile chosen in Settings > Edit, with colours it can't print in magenta.
Proof.default: Off (greyed until a proof profile is chosen).

Version.does: Switches between the photo's own edit (Original) and its virtual copies.
Version.notes: Copies are other edits of the same file - nothing is copied on disk.

New copy.does: Starts a virtual copy from the edit on screen.

⋯.does: Export this copy... or Delete this copy.
⋯.notes: Only for a copy, not the Original.

Presets.does: Import presets... from a file, or Export my filters... to one.
Presets.notes: A filter you already have by that name is left as it is.

Retouch.does: The section with the Heal, Clone and Red-eye tools.
Retouch.inputs: Click the heading to fold or unfold.

Heal.does: Click a spot on the photo to blend it away with what's around it.
Heal.inputs: Turn on, set Size, click on the photo.
Heal.notes: The patch is chosen when you click, so the export matches the preview.

Clone.does: Copies one place of the photo over another.
Clone.inputs: Alt+click where to copy from, then click where to paint.
Clone.notes: Further clicks keep the same offset.

Red-eye.does: Click each red eye; only the red is taken out.

Last used.does: Presets: Last used, ready-made ones (Web, Email, Social, Print matte / glossy, Archive TIFF) and your own.
Last used.notes: A preset fills in every setting but the folder.

Save as preset….does: Keeps the current settings under a name.

Standard.does: How strong the output sharpening is: low, standard or high.
Standard.notes: Sharpening (none, screen, matte, glossy) is added at the exported size, never to the edit.

sRGB (screens, the web, most labs).does: The colour profile the file is converted to and tagged with: sRGB, Display P3, Adobe RGB (1998)-compatible, or a profile of your own (.icc).

Perceptual.does: How colours outside the chosen profile are fitted in: perceptual or relative colorimetric.
Perceptual.notes: Only for a profile other than sRGB.

New smart album….does: Makes an album from rules that keeps itself up to date.

Album tile: Favorites.does: An automatic album: your 4- and 5-star photos.

Album tile: Picks.does: An automatic album: photos flagged Pick.

Scene suggestions.does: Tags the scene model suggested, waiting for your accept.

Review it.does: Opens Review your shoot for a shoot the autopilot sorted out.
Review it.notes: Shows only while a shoot waits for review.

Autopilot.does: After the import, sorts out the shoot for you to review.
Autopilot.notes: Stages: Settings > Library > Shoots, videos and the autopilot.

Preview - nothing is moved.does: Plans the move and shows what would happen, without moving anything.

Fold the sidebar to icons when the windo.does: Folds the sidebar by itself on a narrow window.

Show a RAW+JPEG shot as one photo (stars.does: Shows a RAW and its JPEG as one tile with a badge like ARW+JPG.

Download and turn on.does: Downloads the scene model (once, checked against its fingerprint) and turns scene tags on.

Tag the library….does: Starts a background job that looks at every photo.

Edit the labels….does: Opens the list of scenes the model looks for, to add or change them.

Look at new photos after each scan.does: Suggests scene tags for new photos after each scan.

After each scan, look for brackets, pano.does: Lunelis noticed: looks for shots worth building after each scan.
After each scan, look for brackets, pano.notes: Suggestions wait on Library status; nothing is built by itself.

S-Log3 videos.does: How S-Log3 clips are shown: the built-in look (to Rec.709), your own LUT, or off.
S-Log3 videos.notes: Changing it remakes those clips' thumbnails.

Best frame of each burst.does: Autopilot stage: makes each burst's sharpest frame its cover.

An event.does: Autopilot stage: makes an event with a suggested name.

Edits in your style.does: Autopilot stage: suggests an edit per photo, applied only in the review.

A draft album.does: Autopilot stage: an album of the best frames.

A highlight reel.does: Autopilot stage: offers a slideshow of the best frames, made only in the review.

Monitor profile.does: Shows the photo view and Edit through Windows' display profile.
Monitor profile.notes: For a calibrated monitor. Edits and exports are unaffected.

Re-read files.does: Regular file checks: how often (every week, every month, off) and how much is read each time.
Re-read files.notes: The files checked longest ago go first; damage shows on Damaged files.

Show map tiles (online).does: Turns OpenStreetMap's map pictures on or off.
Show map tiles (online).notes: Only tile numbers are asked for; tiles are kept after the first time.

Fit.does: Shows every photo with a location.

Within 3 days.does: The week around the date instead of just the day.

Keeper rate by.does: What the keeper-rate bars group by: lens, camera, focal length, aperture, ISO or shutter speed.
Keeper rate by.notes: A keeper is a photo flagged Pick.

Focal lengths on.does: Which lens the focal-length chart shows.

Your year.does: Which year the recap is for.

Make a recap picture.does: Saves a picture of the year's numbers to the Create folder.

Build the HDR….does: Lunelis noticed: hands the frames to the matching builder (Build the HDR / panorama, Make the timelapse / focus stack / star trails).
Build the HDR….notes: A merge counts as built when it's saved; a Create tool when it has made the file.

Table: Folder, Status, Photos & videos,.does: Every source: whether it's reachable now, how many photos, how many missing, when it was last scanned.
Table: Folder, Status, Photos & videos,.notes: Offline sources are left alone - nothing is marked missing.

Sensor dust.does: Which camera's dust map to show.
Sensor dust.default: The camera with the most f/8+ photos

Look for dust.does: Reads that camera's f/8-and-narrower photos and makes its dust map.
Look for dust.notes: Runs in the background; the map is kept.

Show the photos.does: Shows the photos a heal would touch.

Heal.does: Adds Heal spots for the dust to those photos' edits.

Undo the last heal.does: Takes off the spots the last heal added.

Done reviewing.does: Closes the review: what's left is kept, waiting stages are skipped.

Undo.does: Takes a finished stage back (the event, the album, the covers, the suggestions it added).

Apply.does: Applies the suggested edits (photos you edited by hand meanwhile are left alone).

Make it.does: Makes the highlight reel in the Create folder.
Make it.notes: Then Play it / Open the folder.

Accept ticked.does: Turns the ticked suggestions into tags.

Reject ticked.does: Drops the ticked suggestions; they aren't suggested again.

Accept all at or above.does: The confidence for Accept all above.

Tick all.does: Ticks every photo in the list.

Accept all above.does: Accepts every suggestion of this tag at or above the confidence.
Accept all above.inputs: Click; Lunelis says how many and asks first.

e.g. sunset on a beach, A7R V, 2024 · 4.notes: Close (or Esc) goes back to the library.

Start here.does: Marks where the trimmed copy starts.

Save trimmed copy.does: Saves the part between the marks as a new file in the Create folder.
Save trimmed copy.notes: Copied, not re-encoded; starts at the keyframe just before the start mark.

PIN (optional).does: A PIN guests type once per browser.
PIN (optional).notes: Stored only as a salted hash. Empty on Update keeps the PIN.

Allow downloading the original files.does: Lets guests download the original files, not just the resized copies.

Update.does: Shares the album (Share) or saves changes (Update).
Update.notes: Shows the link and QR code.

Stop sharing.does: Makes the link useless at once.
Stop sharing.notes: Sharing again makes a new link.

Photos that match.does: Whether photos must match all the rules or any.

ISO.does: A rule's field: stars, label, flag, camera, lens, ISO, aperture, focal length, date, tag...

Num.does: The value the field is compared with.

Table: Where, Keys, What they do.does: Every keyboard shortcut, the screen you're on first.

Default: C:\\Users\\Public\\Lunelis Demo.does: Where an import stages files while it copies and checks them (empty: the data folder's staging folder).
Default: C:\\Users\\Public\\Lunelis Demo.notes: A fast local drive is best.

Default: C:\\Users\\Public\\Lunelis Demo.does: The central sidecar folder (when sidecars are kept in one place).

Default: C:\\Users\\Public\\Lunelis Demo.notes: Another drive protects against this PC's drive failing.
